limitations: BSE and NSE sites were not read: the BSE API call was blocked as bot-check circumvention and not retried, NSE archive downloads failed. The Q4 filing was taken from the company investor page, which hosts the same signed statement.
LODR text is the 2015 gazette plus the 2025 FAQ; amendments after 2015 were not individually verified, page carries a check-current-text note.
Concall transcript timing (five working days) not verified against the notified Schedule III text.
Page numbers are printed numbers; the PDF has 86-page offset after p.90.
Q4 filing figures were read from images, not extracted text; they match the annual totals (20,290.43, 1,546.80) in the same table.

assumptions: Canonical Ramu Chai quarters; sliders replace only FY26 Q3 and Q4 of the chosen measure
YoY needs the same quarter a year earlier (FY26 only); QoQ starts Q2 FY25; TTM starts Q4 FY25
lab.independent_calculation_method: scratchpad lab_test.py: exact Fraction arithmetic in Python, compared with window.labResults and DOM bar geometry; 80 cases: defaults, 4 presets, 4 slider extremes and one arbitrary point for 2 measures x 4 views; map tabs and band clicks
invariants: TTM at Q4 FY26 on defaults = 500 = FY26 revenue; TTM at Q4 FY25 = 450
defaults are the canonical numbers for each measure
bars start at zero; tick scale matches bar ends (check_render)
lab.axis_and_clipping: axis rounds up to cover every value; no clipping; zero left edge unless a value is negative
